reference.classes: DFlash2DraftModel, CandidateSelector, GroupedDynamicCausalConv, Qwen3DFlashDecoderLayer, Qwen3DFlashAttention; dflash_generate's drafting step

transformers.attention: sdpa (the reference's own choice) with its explicit boolean mask

notes.steps: s0: context rows 0..299 (seed 1), anchor 29975 at 300; s1: rows 300..303 (seed 2: the anchor and 3 accepted drafts), anchor 4145 at 304
notes.layout: row-major little-endian; K/V heads are the draft's 8 KV heads of 128
